source: make a kawaii skincare morning routine were you have a kawaii anime character and you wake her up in her kawaii cozy pink bed and do her skincare and make her Breakfast

image_prompt.text: Highly detailed pastel corners of the room built as backdrops for screenshots of the character
An open central floor of the room where players gather
A distinct feature visible from anywhere in the space to orient by
A cozy pink bed with fluffy pillows and blankets where the character wakes up
A vanity or dresser laid out with cute skincare bottles and jars
A small table or tray set for making and eating breakfast
A kawaii anime girl character the player wakes and looks after

notes: Shape forced: this is one bedroom, and every shape in the genre is settlement-scale. Static Settlement was taken as the only shape that does not demand houses, plots or a runway.
Preset caveat: Morph Roleplay assumes a town. Its gathering hub and orientation landmark make no sense in a single room and are flagged in preset_rejected.
The whole build is interior with no exterior, so no outside-to-inside transition is implied and no P3 was added.

open_questions.ask: Is this one bedroom, or a whole little apartment with a separate kitchen?
Does the routine have a scored or timed completion, or is it free play?

theme: Kawaii pastel - soft pink, cute anime styling, warm morning light

coverage_missing.ask: One room, or bedroom plus bathroom plus kitchen?
Is there a score, a timer, or a checklist, or does the player just play house?
Do you play as the character, or care for her as an NPC?

answers.ask: Is this one bedroom, or a whole little apartment with a separate kitchen?
answers.answer: Use one cozy pink bedroom with a small breakfast nook in the same room, keeping the map compact and focused on the morning routine.

answers.ask: Does the routine have a scored or timed completion, or is it free play?
answers.answer: Make it free play with no score or timer, so players can enjoy the kawaii routine at their own pace.
